pricing.title: Pay when you publish online
pricing.subtitle: Create and review your preview for free. Payment only turns on hosting, SSL, and your public link.
pricing.publishFraming: After upload you can edit content and preview. Stripe handles checkout securely—nothing is charged until you pick a plan.

faq.q: Do I have to pay before I see my CV?
faq.a: No. Upload your file, review the preview, and refine your content. You only pay when you want the public link to go live.

faq.q: What does the one-time plan include?
faq.a: Hosting for your digital CV, HTTPS, responsive layout, and a shareable link (e.g. on LinkedIn) for the term shown in the plan.

faq.q: Can I use the monthly plan instead?
faq.a: Yes—same benefits with a smaller recurring payment. Cancel anytime from the Stripe customer portal.
